what_to_detect: The initiative's inherent take-the-initiative trigger, which has no printed line: a trigger record of the engine-defined trigger that fired when a player took the initiative.
near_miss: (No clean near miss: the trigger fires on every taking of the initiative and is evaluated against no other event.)
record_fields: trigger record with empty ability and ability_unresolved engine_effect

what_to_detect: The initiative's inherent upkeep trigger, which has no printed line: a trigger record of the engine-defined trigger that fired at the beginning of the upkeep of the player who has the initiative.
near_miss: The same engine trigger evaluated at the beginning of the upkeep of a player who does not have the initiative, not firing.
record_fields: trigger record with empty ability and ability_unresolved engine_effect

what_to_detect: The initiative's inherent combat-damage trigger, which has no printed line: a trigger record of the engine-defined trigger that fired when creatures a player controls dealt combat damage to the player who has the initiative.
near_miss: The same engine trigger evaluated against combat damage dealt to a player who does not have the initiative, not firing.
record_fields: trigger record with empty ability and ability_unresolved engine_effect

what_to_detect: The engine-defined take-the-initiative trigger fires when the player taking the initiative already has it, while the initiative stays a single designation.
near_miss: (No clean near miss: the trigger fires on every taking of the initiative; the contrast is a taker who did not hold it, which also fires.)
record_fields: trigger record with empty ability and ability_unresolved engine_effect
gen-3 state.players initiative before the event
